description:
To fix reflected XSS here, apply contextual output encoding for HTML content before writing user-controlled data into HTML responses. In Express, a standard and safe approach is to use the well-known `escape-html` package and escape any untrusted value before concatenating into HTML strings. Best fix with minimal functional change: - Edit `src/app.js`. - Add `const escape = require('escape-html');` near existing imports. - In `/preview`, convert `req.query.message` to a string default (to preserve output stability) and escape it before interpolation: - from: `const message = req.query.message;` - to: `const message = escape(String(req.query.message || ''));` - Keep response shape the same (`

...

`) so existing behavior is preserved except unsafe HTML is now rendered harmlessly as text.
